def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    base = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Grid lines are the rows and columns that mostly differ from the interior color.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x != base for x in grid[r]) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != base for r in range(h)) > h / 2]

    out = [[base for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)] for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]]]
            if corners[0] != base and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                out[i][j] = corners[0]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter

    # Identify the repeated lattice-line color and the cell-fill color.
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    line = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fill = counts.most_common(2)[1][0] if len(counts) > 1 else line

    # Lattice crossings are positions where a row and column are both mostly line.
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if sum(v == line for v in grid[r]) > w * .7]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h)) > h * .7]
    marks = [[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]

    # Each output square corresponds to the repeated color of a 2x2 set
    # of lattice crossings. Preserve the intervening blank positions.
    pairs_r = [(i, i + 1) for i in range(len(rs) - 1)]
    pairs_c = [(j, j + 1) for j in range(len(cs) - 1)]
    out = [[fill for _ in pairs_c] for _ in pairs_r]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(pairs_r):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(pairs_c):
            vals = [marks[r0][c0], marks[r0][c1],
                    marks[r1][c0], marks[r1][c1]]
            if vals[0] != line and vals.count(vals[0]) == 4:
                out[i][j] = vals[0]

    # Remove rows/columns with no marked cells, retaining one blank
    # between separated marked bands.
    used_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(out) if any(x != fill for x in row)]
    used_cols = [j for j in range(len(pairs_c)) if any(out[i][j] != fill for i in range(len(pairs_r)))]
    if not used_rows or not used_cols:
        return [[fill]]
    rmin, rmax = min(used_rows), max(used_rows)
    cmin, cmax = min(used_cols), max(used_cols)
    return [row[cmin:cmax + 1] for row in out[rmin:rmax + 1]]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    def mode(seq):
        return Counter(seq).most_common(1)[0]

    # Lattice lines form regularly spaced rows and columns. Find candidate
    # colors from their repeating modal positions, rather than overall frequency.
    row_modes = [mode(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]

    def regularity(positions):
        if len(positions) < 3:
            return 0
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(positions, positions[1:])]
        common_gap = Counter(gaps).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return sum(g == common_gap for g in gaps)

    colors = set(c for c, n in row_modes + col_modes)
    scores = {}
    for color in colors:
        rp = [i for i, (c, n) in enumerate(row_modes)
              if c == color and n >= 0.65 * w]
        cp = [i for i, (c, n) in enumerate(col_modes)
              if c == color and n >= 0.65 * h]
        scores[color] = regularity(rp) + regularity(cp)

    lattice = max(scores, key=scores.get)

    rows = [i for i, (c, n) in enumerate(row_modes)
            if c == lattice and n >= 0.65 * w]
    cols = [i for i, (c, n) in enumerate(col_modes)
            if c == lattice and n >= 0.65 * h]

    # Require regular spacing and discard any accidental line detections.
    def keep_regular(pos):
        if len(pos) < 3:
            return pos
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(pos, pos[1:])]
        step = Counter(gaps).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [p for p in pos if p == pos[0] or (p - pos[0]) % step == 0]

    rows, cols = keep_regular(rows), keep_regular(cols)
    if len(rows) < 3 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [[0]]

    nonline = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != lattice)
    background = nonline.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Ignore the top and bottom frame lines: the colored crossings between
    # them encode the cells of the smaller output.
    inner_rows = rows[1:-1]
    nodes = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in inner_rows]
    out = [[background for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)]
           for _ in range(len(inner_rows) - 1)]

    for i in range(len(inner_rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            vals = [nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j + 1],
                    nodes[i + 1][j], nodes[i + 1][j + 1]]
            if vals[0] != lattice and vals[0] != background and vals.count(vals[0]) == 4:
                out[i][j] = vals[0]

    active_r = [i for i, row in enumerate(out) if any(v != background for v in row)]
    active_c = [j for j in range(len(out[0]))
                if any(out[i][j] != background for i in range(len(out)))]
    if not active_r or not active_c:
        return [[background]]
    return [row[min(active_c):max(active_c) + 1]
            for row in out[min(active_r):max(active_r) + 1]]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    threshold = 0.70

    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [
        Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0]
        for c in range(w)
    ]

    # The lattice color forms near-uniform rows and columns at regular intervals.
    colors = {color for color, n in row_modes if n / w >= threshold}
    colors.update(color for color, n in col_modes if n / h >= threshold)

    def regularity(indices):
        if len(indices) < 2:
            return 0
        gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(indices, indices[1:])]
        gap = Counter(gaps).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return sum(g == gap for g in gaps)

    best_color = None
    best_score = None
    for color in colors:
        rs = [i for i, (c, n) in enumerate(row_modes)
              if c == color and n / w >= threshold]
        cs = [i for i, (c, n) in enumerate(col_modes)
              if c == color and n / h >= threshold]
        score = (min(len(rs), len(cs)),
                 regularity(rs) + regularity(cs),
                 len(rs) + len(cs))
        if best_score is None or score > best_score:
            best_score, best_color = score, color

    lattice = best_color
    rows = [i for i, (c, n) in enumerate(row_modes)
            if c == lattice and n / w >= threshold]
    cols = [i for i, (c, n) in enumerate(col_modes)
            if c == lattice and n / h >= threshold]

    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != lattice).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[background for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)]
           for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]

    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            if corners[0] != lattice and corners[0] != background and corners.count(corners[0]) == 4:
                out[i][j] = corners[0]

    active_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(out)
                   if any(v != background for v in row)]
    active_cols = [j for j in range(len(out[0]))
                   if any(out[i][j] != background for i in range(len(out)))]
    if not active_rows or not active_cols:
        return [[background]]

    return [row[min(active_cols):max(active_cols) + 1]
            for row in out[min(active_rows):max(active_rows) + 1]]
